name: spotify
description: Spotify inside Claude Code: player pane with album art and a visualizer, synced lyrics, a Claude DJ that picks music for what you are working on, a session soundtrack recap, /spotify controls, and tools Claude can use.

clientId.title: Spotify client ID
clientId.description: Client ID of your app at developer.spotify.com (redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:8888/callback). Can also be set with /spotify setup <id>.

showBand.title: Show now-playing band
showBand.description: Show the now-playing row with controls above the prompt.

notify.title: Toast on track change
notify.description: Show a toast when the track changes.
